title: Multi-Dimensional Sensor Streams Dashboard
subtitle: Production-grade scientific dashboard for visualizing complex multi-dimensional animal tracking and environmental telemetry streams
description: A production-grade scientific dashboard designed for visualizing complex multi-dimensional animal tracking and environmental telemetry streams sourced from Movebank. Built using Angular 22 featuring native Signals, stable Zoneless architecture, and modern reactive forms.
longDescription: Engineered for high-frequency environmental and behavioral tracking data, this dashboard leverages stable zoneless architecture and Angular Signals to deliver performant multi-axis charting and real-time statistical evaluation without Zone.js overhead.

architecture.title: Zoneless Charting & Telemetry Pipeline
architecture.description: High-performance reactive architecture optimized for high-frequency environmental data visualization.
steps: Stable zoneless execution utilizing Angular 22 reactivity standards without Zone.js overhead
Synchronized multi-axis time-series charting handling acceleration and temperature streams via Chart.js
Adaptive statistical cards computing real-time minimum, maximum, and average indicators
Fluid CSS grid layout featuring custom SCSS mixins for seamless multi-device responsiveness

scientificImpact: Allows researchers to monitor complex multi-dimensional behavioral telemetry streams in real time
Eliminates rendering bottlenecks during intensive time-series chart updates
Provides immediate statistical evaluation of environmental sensor arrays
keyFeatures: Zoneless and signal-powered state management for peak rendering performance in Angular 22
Synchronized multi-axis time-series graphs for high-frequency sensor streams (Acceleration & Temp)
Fluid responsive grid layouts reflowing smoothly across desktop monitors and mobile devices
Adaptive statistical cards displaying live minimum, maximum, and average indicator metrics
Reactive forms integration allowing custom filtering of telemetry channels on the fly
Optimized chart rendering preventing memory leaks during intensive real-time updates
